Name: Kyuya's Traditional Chinese Costumes converted for Fashion Sense
Author: PeridotUniverse
Description:
Traditional Chinese Dresses by Kyuya258369 is my absolute favorite clothing mod, so I was devastated to find that it was not working with the 1.6 update. So, I decided to update it and convert it to Fashion Sense for my own personal use, and thought that maybe there were other people like myself who would like the mod updated. So, I asked Kyuya for permission to upload the conversion and they said yes!

The original mod can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6134]here[/url]. It is not required, but please go over there and give the original creator lots of love and support!!! They're the one who made this beautiful mod in the first place, I just converted it!

This mod includes everything included in the original, plus the hairs from the optional .png. Please reach out if you encounter any issues!
